lesson.card_text:
Inspect native population MRI, labels and probabilities

Inspect all native planes through the six full putamen and pallidal source selections, with all three median/IQR contrasts and separate atlas probabilities. These are adult population templates: MRI from 105 subjects and atlas labels from 97. Their declared source grids correspond without resampling; patient registration, clinical boundaries and fine laminae remain unverified.

Bazin, Forstmann, Alkemade, Miletic and Isherwood. MASSP 2.0 lifespan atlas v2 and AHEAD quantitative MRI templates v3. CC BY 4.0. Adaptation: lossless native regional crop, exact source-label encoding, display windows and direct unchanged-model sections.

capture_review.method: Contact sheets plus individual document sections; native-size views intentionally scroll rather than crop source pixels. Full RGB checks cover every source PNG.
capture_review.document_section_capture_limitation: Fixed reader header appears across some tall element captures; it is a screenshot compositing/viewport limitation. All original links, complete text/attribution and no document horizontal overflow were checked separately.

bounded_uterine_amendments.affected_tests: 11 passed in 19.40s; original and previous amendment bytes preserved

observation_history: Desktop reader checks passed before a mobile initial-navigation observation timeout; the same live server rendered both mobile routes in a bounded diagnostic with no errors. Harness now waits for initial application readiness; completed desktop evidence was retained while remaining routes continued.

After all GUI/cloud-image configurations passed, a new packet-only browser request context returned401 because it had not signed in. The harness authenticated that new context and resumed packet checks without repeating passed GUI checks.

Parent backend provenance and exact canonical-path/ID/false-flag policies changed after server startup. A fresh cold ASGI process verifies current GET/HEAD/auth/307/404/CSP and unchanged valid case output, without reusing warm Python modules.
